decisions.reason: The firm invested in this two-component injection unit and presents it publicly, plural-component technology is central to its announced direction, and weak results during 2020-2021 can still be attributed to pandemic-related construction disruptions, so management persists.
As a second injection unit it carries somewhat more overlap risk with Product A, but it supports the tailored-solutions strategy and the firm has committed to it publicly, so management keeps it.
A manual airless gun is a staple complement to the firm's pumps with low ongoing cost, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
This multi-model air-assisted airless line is a substantial and visible investment in the firm's core spray technology, so management stays committed.
